extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
Each Draft Booster contains 15 cards and 1 token/ad card, including 1 card of rarity Rare or higher and 3 Uncommons, 10 Commons, and 1 Land cards. Traditional Foil Borderless Mythic Planeswalker in <1% of boosters. Traditional Foil of any rarity replaces a Common in 33% of boosters.
Contents:
• 15 Magic cards per booster
• 1 card of rarity Rare or higher in every pack
• 1 Traditional Foil card in 33% of packs
• Glory to Phyrexia—resist the Phyrexian invasion or forfeit your flesh to join them in perfection
